solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Christian compromised ultimately — one taking gold

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of the word compromised

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I
or is the heraldic word for gold

explanation.surface: A Christian who sold out in the end by accepting gold.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Christian' looks like a believer, but it is the first name of the French fashion designer.
explanation.definitionFit: Christian Dior was the French couturier who founded the famous fashion house.

clue.text: 'Countdown' may be followed by this criticism that's turned sour

parts.note: a blast is a severe dressing-down or criticism
milk that has turned sour has gone off

explanation.surface: A TV quiz show attracting complaints that have gone sour.
explanation.walkthrough: Countdown is also a long-running British TV word-and-numbers quiz, which the surface plays on; here it is a rocket launch countdown.
explanation.definitionFit: A rocket launch countdown ends with the moment of lift-off, so this follows it.

clue.text: Courageously showing leg, see

parts.note: gam is a slang word for a leg
a see is a bishop's diocese, and Ely is a cathedral city in Cambridgeshire

explanation.surface: Bravely displaying a leg, look.
explanation.walkthrough: 'see' looks like the verb 'look', but it is a bishop's diocese; Ely is the crossword's favourite.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something gamely means doing it bravely and willingly, so the adverbs are synonyms.

clue.text: Wife wants everyone to flourish — I'm rather shy

parts.note: everyone means all
to flower is to bloom or flourish

explanation.surface: A wife longs for everybody to thrive, though she herself is timid.
explanation.definitionFit: A wallflower is a shy person who stays at the edge of a party; the clue speaks in that person's voice.

clue.text: Head of State got rid of expert

indicators.note: head of picks out the first letter of the word State

parts.note: to get rid of someone can mean to kill them

explanation.surface: A head of state disposed of an expert.
explanation.definitionFit: An expert is skilled, so the adjective and the noun-used-as-adjective are synonyms.

clue.text: Cut evident when son's been give whip

parts.note: S is the standard abbreviation for son
a lash is a whip

explanation.surface: A wound shows up after the boy has been whipped.
explanation.walkthrough: 'been give' is as the clue was filed, presumably 'been given'; the parse is unaffected.
explanation.definitionFit: A slash is a long cut made with a sweeping stroke.

clue.text: Detachment from event of 24 February 1981

definitions.meaning: a withdrawing or separation, as of troops from conflict
the date Prince Charles and Lady Diana announced that they would marry

explanation.surface: Separation from an occasion in early 1981.
explanation.walkthrough: On 24 February 1981 the engagement of Prince Charles and Lady Diana Spencer was announced: split the answer as DI'S ENGAGEMENT.
explanation.definitionFit: Disengagement is the act of pulling out or detaching oneself.

clue.text: An attempt to bring shame

parts.note: to have a bash is to have a go or attempt

explanation.surface: Trying to embarrass someone.
explanation.definitionFit: To abash someone is to make them feel embarrassed or ashamed.

clue.text: Eager to get across a country

indicators.note: the word for eager is placed across, so it spans either side of the letter a

parts.note: hungry means eager, as in hungry for success

explanation.surface: Keen to cross a nation's border.
explanation.definitionFit: Hungary is a landlocked country in central Europe.

clue.text: Whiskery beast was outside front of local before game

indicators.note: the word was is placed outside, wrapped round the other letters

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: before puts the first letter ahead of the game
front of selects the first letter of the word local

parts.note: RU is rugby union, a game

explanation.surface: A bewhiskered animal stood outside the pub before a match.
explanation.walkthrough: 'local' looks like a pub, but only its first letter L is used.
explanation.definitionFit: The walrus is a large Arctic sea mammal famous for its long whiskers and tusks.

clue.text: Around spring grass is growing

indicators.note: around tells us the second word's synonym goes round the first word's synonym

parts.note: to grass is to inform on someone, to sing
a well is a spring of water

explanation.surface: Grass is growing up round a water source.
explanation.walkthrough: 'grass' looks like lawn, but it is the slang verb for informing, SING.
explanation.definitionFit: Swelling means increasing in size, so it is a synonym of growing.

clue.text: Summer ending in debauchery after tea and wine

indicators.note: after puts the singer and the last letter behind the tea

parts.note: char is slang for tea
Donna Summer was the American disco singer

indicators.note: ending in picks out the final letter of the word debauchery

explanation.surface: A summer of excess winds up with tea and wine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Summer' looks like the season, but it is the disco singer Donna Summer.
explanation.definitionFit: Chardonnay is a popular white wine grape and the wine made from it.

clue.text: Star rector played instruments in theatre

indicators.note: played suggests the letters are performed in a different arrangement

explanation.surface: A celebrated clergyman performed in a theatre.
explanation.walkthrough: 'theatre' is the operating theatre, not the stage.
explanation.definitionFit: Retractors are surgical instruments used to hold back the edges of an incision.

clue.text: Meadow has fine bit of greenery

parts.note: lea is a poetic word for a meadow
F stands for fine, as on pencil grades

explanation.surface: A meadow contains some pleasant greenery.
explanation.definitionFit: A leaf is a single part of a plant's foliage, a small piece of greenery.

clue.text: How a foray must get organised so that danger can be avoided

definitions.text: so that danger can be avoided

indicators.note: get organised tells us the letters must be put into a new order

explanation.surface: A raid must be planned carefully to stay safe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'get organised' rearranges the thirteen letters of HOW A FORAY MUST.
explanation.definitionFit: Being out of harm's way means being in a safe place, beyond danger.

clue.text: Where granny keeps blanket? It suggests a double layer

definitions.meaning: a blanket tucked over a grandmother's knees sits across her lap
a part where one thing extends across another, making two thicknesses

explanation.walkthrough: The first definition splits the answer as OVER LAP.
explanation.definitionFit: An overlap is where one thing covers part of another, giving two layers.

clue.text: A bit of time with hesitation — so this is lost?

parts.note: a moment is a short time
um is the sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: Pausing for a second means losing impetus.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue reads as a whole: hesitating causes this to be lost.
explanation.definitionFit: Momentum is impetus, which is lost when someone hesitates.

clue.text: One Greek character born shortly before another

indicators.note: before places the abbreviation ahead of the other letter

parts.note: B is the short form of born, as in records
eta is another Greek letter

explanation.surface: A Greek man is born a little earlier than another one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'character' looks like a person, but it is a letter of the alphabet.
explanation.definitionFit: Beta is the second letter of the Greek alphabet.

clue.text: Female left tea-maker out in second-hand sale

indicators.note: out suggests the letters are disordered or broken

explanation.surface: A woman abandoned her teapot at a jumble sale.
explanation.definitionFit: A flea market is a street market selling second-hand goods.

clue.text: A picture could be so planned

definitions.meaning: a picture may be put in a frame

explanation.definitionFit: Framed means mounted in a frame, and also formulated or devised.

clue.text: Yemen possibly a very unfriendly state?

indicators.note: possibly suggests the letters may be shuffled into a new order

explanation.surface: Could Yemen be a hostile nation?
explanation.definitionFit: An enemy is a hostile power, a nation at war with one's own.

clue.text: Person lived with is monotonous and dull, with little energy

parts.note: flat means monotonous, lacking variation
mat or matt means dull, not shiny
E is the abbreviation for energy

explanation.surface: A housemate is boring and lifeless, with hardly any energy.
explanation.definitionFit: A flatmate is someone who shares a flat, so a person one lives with.

clue.text: Lower something to catch fish here (last one gets away)

parts.note: a net is used to catch fish

indicators.note: the final letter of the word here escapes and is dropped

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Lower a net to catch fish here, but the last one escapes.
explanation.definitionFit: Nether means lower, as in the nether regions.

clue.text: Pacific kingdom expelling a Chinese guild

indicators.note: expelling means throwing out the letter a

parts.note: Tonga is a kingdom of Pacific islands

explanation.surface: An island kingdom throws out a Chinese society.
explanation.definitionFit: A tong is a Chinese association or secret society, especially among emigrants.

clue.text: Prince longing for a clear-out of unwanted people?

parts.note: an urge is a longing or desire

explanation.surface: A royal yearns to get rid of unwanted courtiers.
explanation.definitionFit: A purge is the removal of undesirable members from a group.

clue.text: Medieval games would get ye to run around

indicators.note: around tells us these letters are turned about into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Knightly contests would make you run around.
explanation.definitionFit: A tourney is a medieval tournament of jousting knights.
